_meta.scope: Adult primary-care USPSTF Grade A and Grade B recommendations as of May 2026. Subset of ~37 recs synthesized from the source page on 2026-05-03. Updated annually.

recommendations.title: Breast Cancer Screening
recommendations.recommendation_text: Biennial screening mammography for women aged 40-74 years.

recommendations.title: Cervical Cancer Screening
recommendations.recommendation_text: Cytology every 3 years OR HPV testing (alone or co-test) every 5 years for women 21-65.

recommendations.title: Colorectal Cancer Screening
recommendations.recommendation_text: Screening for all adults 50-75 using approved strategies (colonoscopy, FIT, Cologuard, etc.). Begin at 45 (Grade B).

recommendations.title: Lung Cancer Screening
recommendations.recommendation_text: Annual low-dose CT for adults 50-80 with 20+ pack-year smoking history (current or quit within 15 years).

recommendations.title: Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Screening
recommendations.recommendation_text: One-time ultrasound screening for men 65-75 who have ever smoked.

recommendations.title: Hypertension Screening
recommendations.recommendation_text: Office BP measurement with out-of-office confirmation for adults 18+ without HTN diagnosis.

recommendations.title: Statin Use for Primary Prevention of CVD
recommendations.recommendation_text: Clinician-prescribed statin for adults 40-75 with ≥1 CVD risk factor and ≥10% 10-year ASCVD risk.

recommendations.title: Prediabetes and Type 2 Diabetes Screening
recommendations.recommendation_text: Screen adults 35-70 with overweight/obesity for prediabetes and T2DM. Refer prediabetes to prevention interventions.

recommendations.title: Adult Obesity: Intensive Behavioral Intervention
recommendations.recommendation_text: Intensive multicomponent behavioral interventions for adults with BMI ≥30.

recommendations.title: Hepatitis C Virus Screening
recommendations.recommendation_text: Universal HCV screening for adults 18-79.

recommendations.title: HIV Infection Screening
recommendations.recommendation_text: Universal screening for adolescents/adults 15-65 (younger/older if at risk).

recommendations.title: Latent Tuberculosis Infection Screening
recommendations.recommendation_text: Screen at-risk asymptomatic adults for latent TB infection.

recommendations.title: Depression Screening
recommendations.recommendation_text: Screen adults including pregnant/postpartum and 65+ for depression with follow-up plan.

recommendations.title: Anxiety Disorders Screening (Adults)
recommendations.recommendation_text: Screen adults ≤64 for anxiety disorders.

recommendations.title: Unhealthy Alcohol Use Screening + Brief Counseling
recommendations.recommendation_text: Screen adults 18+ (incl. pregnant) for risky/hazardous drinking; provide brief behavioral counseling.

recommendations.title: Unhealthy Drug Use Screening
recommendations.recommendation_text: Screen adults 18+ via questioning about drug use.

recommendations.title: Tobacco Smoking Cessation (Nonpregnant Adults)
recommendations.recommendation_text: Ask, advise cessation, and provide behavioral and/or pharmacologic interventions.

recommendations.title: Falls Prevention Interventions in Older Adults
recommendations.recommendation_text: Exercise interventions; multifactorial assessment for adults 65+ at increased fall risk.

recommendations.title: Intimate Partner Violence Screening
recommendations.recommendation_text: Screen reproductive-age women including perinatal for IPV; provide intervention.

recommendations.title: Osteoporosis Screening (Postmenopausal Women)
recommendations.recommendation_text: Bone density screening for postmenopausal women per risk factors.

recommendations.title: Folic Acid Supplementation
recommendations.recommendation_text: Daily 0.4-0.8 mg folic acid for persons planning or able to become pregnant.
